headline: HELIOSTAR DRILLS 99.8m AT 10.9 g/t GOLD AT ANA PAULA EXPANSION ZONE — $426M PROJECT CONFIRMS BIGGER PRIZE; GUERRERO, MEXICO (TSXV:HSTR)
snippet: Heliostar Metals (TSXV:HSTR) announced June 25 that drill hole AP-26-381 at the Ana Paula Gold Project in Guerrero, Mexico returned 99.8 metres grading 10.9 g/t gold from 50.5 metres depth — adding an Expansion Zone footprint above and adjacent to the existing High Grade Panel that analysts at The Northern Miner flagged is pointing toward a 'big prize' at the US$426M-valued project. The width and continuity of high-grade mineralisation at the shallow Expansion Zone changes the open-pit economics meaningfully compared to the known underground resource.

headline: NEXGOLD'S GOLDBORO INFILL HITS 61.22 g/t AU OVER 12m — 685 g/t PEAK IN 1m, 65% OF 30,000m RC PROGRAM COMPLETE; NOVA SCOTIA (TSXV:NEXG)
snippet: NexGold Mining Corp. (TSXV:NEXG) reported June 25 initial results from the detailed reverse-circulation infill program at its Goldboro Gold Project in Nova Scotia: highlight hole RC-26-073 returned 61.22 g/t gold over 12.0 metres from 18 metres depth — including a spectacular 685 g/t over 1.0 metre — alongside RC-26-074 which returned 5.85 g/t over 13.0 metres, with 65% of the planned 30,000-metre, 600-hole program now complete and designed to lift the resource to a 12.5-metre drill spacing ahead of a feasibility study.

headline: ENDURANCE GOLD STEPS 25m UP-DIP OUTSIDE RESOURCE AT RELIANCE — 7.67 g/t AU OVER 14.7m EAGLE ZONE; BRIDGE RIVER, BC (TSXV:EDG)
snippet: Endurance Gold (TSXV:EDG) released June 24 the first assays from its 2026 eight-thousand-metre program at the Reliance Gold Project, 4km east of Gold Bridge in BC's Bridge River camp: hole DDH26-128 returned 14.7 metres at 7.67 g/t gold and 0.13% antimony from 75.9 metres — a 25-metre up-dip expansion of the near-surface Eagle Zone not previously included in the existing 1.45-million-ounce inferred resource — with step-out DDH26-129 confirming the trend 60 metres along strike. Both intercepts are outside the current resource and represent incremental potential feeding into a planned PEA this year.

headline: ORESTONE UNCOVERS TWO NEW GOLD SYSTEMS AT FRANCISCA — 21m AT 4.45 g/t AU (TOM EAST ZONE); SALTA, ARGENTINA (TSXV:ORS)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Orestone Mining Corp. (TSXV:ORS)
snippet: Orestone Mining (TSXV:ORS) announced June 26 completion of its Phase I mapping and sampling program at the Francisca Gold-Silver Property in Salta Province, Argentina, identifying two new gold mineralised systems flanking the known South and North Gold Zones: the Tom East Zone, located 120 metres east, returned 21 metres at 4.45 g/t gold in colluvium from Trench 6B, while the Kelly Gold Zone shows broad stockwork grades of 0.24–0.41 g/t gold across an emerging corridor — alongside a 332-sample average of 1.04 g/t Au and 7.80 g/t Ag from 18 trenches on the main zones, establishing a significantly wider mineralised system than the original target.

headline: DLP's ESPERANZA PERU COPPER-GOLD FOOTPRINT HITS 5km × 2.5km — 7.8 g/t AU FROM SURFACE; MAIDEN DRILL PROGRAM SET Q3 2026 (TSXV:DLP)
source_name: Investing News Network / DLP Resources Inc. (TSXV:DLP)
snippet: DLP Resources (TSXV:DLP) announced June 25 that surface rock chip sampling at the Esperanza Project in southern Peru returned up to 7.8 g/t gold and 27.7 g/t silver alongside the copper-molybdenum values previously announced, expanding the confirmed mineralised footprint to 5km × 2.5km — one of southern Peru's largest undrilled porphyry copper-gold targets. A maiden 3,000-metre diamond drill program is advancing through permitting with an August 2026 start targeted, representing the first-ever drilling of what the company considers an Andean porphyry analogous to world-class producing systems in the region.

headline: 4 DAYS TO DEADLINE: COPPER TARIFF DECISION LOOMS — COMMERCE DEPT JUNE 30 REPORT COULD TRIGGER 15% THEN 30% DUTY ON REFINED COPPER; HBM, FCX IN CROSSHAIRS
snippet: The U.S. Secretary of Commerce must deliver a formal update on domestic copper markets to President Trump by June 30, 2026 — four days away — triggering a decision on whether to impose phased Section 232 tariffs on refined copper imports: 15% from January 1, 2027, rising to 30% from January 1, 2028. Jefferies identified Hudbay Minerals (TSX:HBM), Freeport-McMoRan, and Ivanhoe Electric as having the most direct exposure to a US copper price premium; a tariff outcome of this scale, layered onto existing 50% duties on semi-finished copper products (in effect since August 2025), would fundamentally re-price North American copper producer economics.

headline: TECK RESOURCES LEADS $7.4M INTO VISIONARY METALS' WYOMING Ni-Cu PLAYS — KING SOLOMON + TIN CUP DRILLING NEXT; BC PORPHYRY TOO (TSXV:VIZ)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Visionary Metals Corp. (TSXV:VIZ)
snippet: Visionary Metals Corp. (TSXV:VIZ) closed a C$7.445 million financing on June 26, including a direct C$1.2 million strategic investment by Teck Resources Limited — one of the largest copper miners in the world — validating Visionary's King Solomon and Tin Cup nickel-copper sulphide projects in Wyoming, which will receive at least C$2.4 million in combined Teck-backed drilling this season alongside advancement of the company's 100%-owned Slipstream copper-gold-silver porphyry assets in British Columbia.

headline: CHINA DETAINS TWO MORE JAPANESE NATIONALS IN RARE EARTH CASE — HEAVY EARTH EXPORTS TO JAPAN REMAIN ZERO; CORPORATE RISK WIDENS
snippet: Chinese authorities detained two Japanese nationals in the port city of Dalian in May — one on May 18, one on May 25 — on suspicion of smuggling goods prohibited from import or export, in what Tokyo said Wednesday may be tied to rare earth-related export compliance issues; the case is escalating corporate legal risk for Japanese companies operating in Chinese supply chains at precisely the moment heavy rare earth exports from China to Japan remain at near-zero, forcing a review of logistics operations and export compliance procedures across Japan's electrical, electronics, and automotive sectors.

headline: G7 TARGETS 60% CAP ON SINGLE SUPPLIER RARE EARTH DEPENDENCE BY 2030 — JAPAN PROPOSES COORDINATED PRICE FLOORS AS CHINA GRIP TIGHTENS
snippet: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi secured a commitment at the G7 Evian Summit in June 2026 to set a target of reducing dependence on any single non-G7 rare earth supplier to below 60% by 2030, alongside a new IEA-coordinated market monitoring platform and a coordinated stockpiling mechanism with lithium and nickel designated as the first pilot metals. Japan's Shin-Etsu Chemical is separately building a 35-billion-yen (US$218 million) domestic rare earth refinery in Fukui as the country's largest magnet makers accelerate domestic supply diversification following near-zero heavy rare earth deliveries from China since January.

headline: BIPARTISAN SENATORS FILE SILVER ACT TO NDAA — ENDS NYC MONOPOLY ON GOLD AND SILVER VAULTS IN NATIONAL SECURITY FRAMING
snippet: Senators Catherine Cortez Masto (D-NV) and Jim Risch (R-ID) filed the SILVER Act as an amendment to the FY2027 National Defense Authorization Act on June 25, escalating what began as a market-structure reform into an explicit national security issue: all major gold, silver, platinum, and palladium exchange-approved depositories currently sit in or near New York City, creating a single-point-of-failure the legislation would cure by mandating approved vaults in each U.S. time zone. The CFTC Chairman has publicly supported the bill, and its NDAA vehicle gives it substantially higher odds of passing than a standalone bill.

headline: GOLD-SILVER RATIO CLOSES WEEK AT 69.3 — HIGHEST SINCE US-IRAN WAR PEAK; GOLDSILVER: 'RATIO SAYS SILVER IS LOADING'
snippet: The gold-silver ratio closed Friday at 69.3:1 — its highest weekly close since the early weeks of the US-Iran conflict — with silver down 5.4% for the week against gold's 1.7% decline as the Federal Reserve's hawkish repricing activated silver's monetary engine in reverse. GoldSilver.com argues the setup is historically associated with rate-hike dominance near exhaustion: the 14-point ratio compression from 69 to 54.9 during the US-China tariff truce in late May was driven by 14 ounces of silver per point of movement — and at 69.3, the argument is that the same setup is reloading for the next compression cycle when Fed pressure eases.
